description: Verifies the attachments[].content_hash procedure in SPEC.md section 6.1: SHA-256 of the ORIGINAL BINARY BYTES, computed before base64 encoding, never of the base64 text itself.
how_to_check: Base64-decode content_base64 into bytes, take the SHA-256 of those bytes, format as lowercase hex, and confirm it equals content_hash_sha256_hex. If you instead hash the base64 text itself, you will get a different value -- that mismatch is the most common first-implementation bug (see SPEC.md section 6.1).
